description_en: Polyurethane-24 is a complex polymer prepared via the following multi-step synthesis. key: r escherichia coli thioredoxin 1 heptapeptide 20 hexapeptide 40 oligopeptide 113 sh polypeptide 70
description_en: r- Escherichia Coli Thioredoxin-1 Heptapeptide-20 Hexapeptide-40 Oligopeptide-113 sh-Polypeptide-70 is a single chain recombinant fusion peptide produced by fermentation in E. coli. name: SILICONE QUATERNIUM-27
description_en: Silicone Quaternium-27 is a complex silicone polymer that is made in several steps. First, Glycidoxy Dimethicone is reacted with dimethylamine. The resulting siloxane polymer is then quaternized by reacting the tertiary amine groups created in the previous step with a glycidoxy-terminated polypropylene glycol that contains an average of seven mols of polypropylene oxide. Finally, additional quaternary ammonium groups are created on the silicone polymer by reacting epoxy groups left over from the previous step with dodecyldimethyl amine. The last two reactions are done in the presence of acetic acid so that the positive charges on the finished polymer are balanced by acetate ions.
